engine: Python binary stabilizer and BP-OSD simulation
justification: This is Pauli-channel quantum decoding, not a structural equation model. lavaan and OpenMx cannot implement the target estimand. Use historical bn3d as reference plus separately written sparse min-sum and GF(2) OSD.
independent_validation: Planned before production: independently constructed periodic cell incidence matrices against historical code, dense historical BP-OSD versus sparse implementation on identical error vectors, separate random generator and iteration-count sensitivity. Shared NumPy arithmetic and source definitions will be disclosed.
